header: THE FLIGHTS TO AND FROM ANDAL AIRPORT (Kazi Nazrul Islam Airport, Durgapur, RDP), from the AIRPORT'S OWN website: https://kniairport.com/flights/ (the "Flight Information" page, free and open to anyone). That page lists the airport's flights as cards (the airline, the other airport, the two times, the flight number), each marked Departure or Arrival, and says when it was last updated. Here I read it, check it, and nothing else: it is the airport's TIMETABLE, not live status (the airport's own page says: "for realtime flight data please contact the airport support desk"; its Live Arrivals and Live Departures boards are linked from the card, not read). A page whose layout is not the one expected is an error, and I never guess at the times. HOW A CARD READS. Each card shows two times: the first, under the Durgapur label, is the time AT DURGAPUR; the second, under the other airport's name, is the time AT THE OTHER AIRPORT. a Departure card: leaves Durgapur at the first time, reaches the other airport at the second. an Arrival card: leaves the other airport at the second time, reaches Durgapur at the first. Checked on the real page: every flight then takes between about 1 h 50 min and 3 h 10 min, which is right for these routes; I refuse a card whose flight time comes out under half an hour or over six hours.

doc: The two-letter airline codes of the airlines that have flown from here (standard IATA codes). An airline not in the table is shown by its name and the number alone: I never guess a code.

members.name: number
doc: Either "6E 509", or "509" for an airline whose code is not in the table.

members.name: city
doc: The other airport's city ("Bengaluru") and code ("BLR").

members.name: time
doc: The time at Durgapur ("08:55"), and the time at the other airport.

members.name: minutes
doc: The minutes in the air, as the two times give them.

members.name: updatedAt
doc: When the airport's page says it was last updated (ISO, UTC).

members.name: departures
doc: Flights leaving Durgapur, ordered by the time of leaving.

members.name: arrivals
doc: Flights reaching Durgapur, ordered by the time of arriving.

symbols.name: parseFlights
symbols.sig: export function parseFlights(html: string, now: DateTime = DateTime.now()): Flights
doc: I read the airport's flight page here and check it.

symbols.name: nextFlight
symbols.sig: export function nextFlight(list: Flight[], at: string): Flight | null
doc: Returns the next flight at or after `at` (a time at Durgapur, "HH:mm") in a list sorted by time, or null when none is left in the list.

symbols.name: until
symbols.sig: export function until(at: string, time: string): string
doc: Gives "in 1 h 20 min" or "in 35 min": the minutes from `at` to the flight's time, both "HH:mm" at Durgapur.

behaviours: the airport is Kazi Nazrul Islam Airport (RDP), read from the airport's own flight page, and the page's own live boards are linked, not read
the real page gives six departures and six arrivals (the old cards left in its markup, outside the flight list, are not read)
the page's update stamp (12-11-2026 20:20:36 IST) is read
a Departure card: IndiGo 509 leaves Durgapur 08:55 and reaches Bengaluru 11:35 (2 h 40 min)
an Arrival card: IndiGo 508 leaves Bengaluru 05:45 and reaches Durgapur 08:15 (2 h 30 min): the times of an arrival are read the other way round
the routes are Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Delhi (two a day each way) and Mumbai, each way
every flight takes between 1 h 30 min and 3 h 30 min, which is right for these routes
the lists are in order of the time at Durgapur
an IndiGo number carries its standard code (6E 509); every flight has an airline name
the last departure of the day is the Mumbai flight at 20:10 (which lands at 23:05)
the next flight is the first at or after the time; none is left late in the evening
durations and waits are said plainly: '2 h 30 min', '45 min', '2 h', 'in 1 h 20 min', 'now'
a page with no update stamp, no flight list or no flights is refused
an unreadable card is refused: no flight number, a time that is not a time
a card that is not to or from Durgapur is refused, and so is a page laid out the other way round
an impossible flight time is refused (a flight that arrives 20 minutes after it leaves)
an unusable update time (in the far future) is refused
